tools.name: status
tools.description: Data age for metrics, statements, ownership, and macro. Costs 0 credits. Authenticated on the hosted connector like every other tool; the underlying /v1/status route itself needs no key. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess). A figure can change or disappear when a later filing arrive

A figure can change or disappear when a later filing arrives; figures are not versioned. Read `adjustments` for extractor decisions beyond copying one filed figure. This is filing data, not investment
